prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production VFX texture atlas for a Korean fantasy RPG +10 enchanted equipment inventory aura, actual transparent raster sprites, not a UI mockup.
Create one square texture atlas in a precise 2 by 2 grid of four separate magical energy textures. Each sprite is centered in its own quadrant with at least 10 percent fully transparent padding. All sprites entirely contained in their own quadrants, no overlap.
Top left: a tall irregular tongue of luminous molten gold magical flame flowing upward, white-hot narrow core, layered wispy amber/gold filaments and translucent fringes, powerful supernatural energy not ordinary candle fire.
Top right: a different wider branching gold energy plume fanning upward from a compact luminous base, turbulent curling flame tongues and fine sparks, richly layered luminous texture.
Bottom left: a narrow jagged branching golden electrical arc travelling upward diagonally, irregular forks, intense ivory core and amber glow, no straight rectangle or circle.
Bottom right: a compact cloud of several tiny floating gold embers with soft radiant trails, airy luminous particle texture.
Style: premium hand-painted game spell VFX, crisp bright cores with organic translucent flowing edges, vivid gold, warm amber, pale ivory highlights. Effect only, no equipment, no objects, no characters, no background, no shadows, no UI, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no border or frame, no circular ring, no four-point star icons. Real alpha transparency. The effects must read strongly at small inventory-icon sizes. Do not fill the sheet with opaque haze; empty space must remain fully transparent.
